PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.en: Hi, Simba! I could use your help. I need to find Peter Pan.
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.cz: Ahoj, Simbo! Hodila by se mi tvoje pomoc. Potřebuji najít Petra Pana.
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.original_cz: Ahoj, Simbo! Hodila by se mi tvoje pomoc. Potřebuji najít Petra Pana.

PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.en: That's the young guy, right? With a bit of a mischievous streak?
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.cz: To je ten mladík, že? S trochou zlomyslnosti?
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.original_cz: To je ten mladík, že? S trochou zlomyslnosti?

PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.en: That's him. We're playing hide-and-seek, but I have no idea where to look for him.
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.cz: To je on. Hrajeme si na schovávanou, ale nemám tušení, kde ho hledat.

PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.en: He seems like he'd be the tricky sort. I bet he's hiding somewhere different, outside the regular Valley.
PeterPan_Simba/Simba_MRQS144_MusicWalls_.cz: Vypadá to, že by to byl ten záludný typ. Vsadím se, že se schovává někde jinde, mimo obvyklé Údolí.
